newsitem.title: USA: PCX files for options on new emerging growth index.
newsitem.headline: PCX files for options on new emerging growth index.

text.p: The Pacific Exchange (PCX) said Tuesday it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for approval to trade options on a new emerging growth index.
The options will be based on the Morgan Stanley Emerging Growth Index, a capitalization-weighted average of 50 stocks in industries such as computer software, electronic components and retail.
The PCX said it anticipated beginning options trading on the new index in "late summer", pending regulatory approval.

Companies in the index include American Power Conversion Corp, Bed Bath & Beyond Inc, Cambridge Technology Partners Inc, Iomega Corp, Learning Tree International Inc, Reading & Bates Corp and Xilinx Inc.

Initially, the companies in the index had a market capitalization of between $500 million and $8 billion, a three-year earnings per share growth rate of 23 percent, sales of between $25 million and $2.5 billion and a share price of at least $10, the exchange said.
